html: The Ts'uubaa-asatx are a small First Nation of Cowichan Lake on southern Vancouver Island, British Columbia, also known as the Lake Cowichan First Nation. Their ancestors are linked to the Ditidaht, a Nuu-chah-nulth people of the outer coast, though they lived inland at the head of the Cowichan valley. They hunted elk and deer and fished the lake and river. The Cowichan people live downstream, and the wider Nuu-chah-nulth nations hold the west coast.
